# Correct the latest release date
originator: kouko
kind: engineering
needs-design: yes — The release notes are a reader-facing artifact with no existing design coverage.
status: open

## Problem
Readers cannot determine when the latest version became available from the current release date entry.

## Proposed outcome
The latest release notes show the verified release date.

## Acceptance
1. The displayed release date matches verified release information.
2. All other existing release note text remains unchanged.

## Constraints
- The actual release date is unknown, and the user has no release records to provide.
- Do not invent a date or silently substitute another meaning for the release date.
- Stop at intent confirmation; do not implement or publish.
- Do not send messages or run an external coding agent.
- Access only this fixture and the referenced snapshot.

## Out of scope
- Changes to other release note text.

## Open questions
- Should this request remain pending without edits until the actual release date can be verified, or does the user want a different outcome for the date display?

kind: engineering

## Acceptance
1. The displayed release date matches verified release evidence.
2. All other release-note text remains unchanged.

## Constraints
- The actual release date is unknown, and the user has no release records to provide.
- Do not implement or publish before a further user response.
- Do not send messages or run an external coding agent.
- Access only this fixture and the specified skill snapshot.

## Out of scope
- Changes to other release-note text or application behavior.
